newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Wednesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well established. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light, USDA said. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150 lbs ld 68.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Wednesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well established with a lower undertone noted.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs few 109.50 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 104.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 105.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 101.00.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
For the week - 23,000 Wk ago - 26,000 Yr ago - 33,800
Steers and heifers - Live basis - weak to $0.50 per cwt lower.
Carcass basis - unevenly steady to 1.00 lower.
Wk to Date - 22,000 Week Ago - 26,000 Year Ago - 33,800
